notes.title: The 1.0 version is about to make its grand entrance!
notes.notes:
The 1.0 version is about to make its grand entrance!

This 2023 has been an exceptionally dynamic year, full of challenges and valuable lessons. Thanks to your immense support, I am about to cross the finish line with version 1.0. Although there are a few more days of polishing, this does not imply that the launch is the conclusion of our journey. I will definitely continue exploring ways to enhance the gaming experience and simultaneously expand our universe with my next project, "EON Trooper". In this project, players will immerse themselves in an entirely new dynamic where stealth and explosive action will be the real protagonists.

What can you anticipate from version 1.0?

I have expanded the lore by introducing interactions with the enemies. Each one of them, endowed with unique personalities, adds greater depth to the antagonism, making each victory even more rewarding!

The experience system has also been revamped. Even though the amount of experience gained has been slightly reduced, I have incorporated a new system of "killstreaks" that provides experience bonuses and encourages strategic combat. How far will you go? Assassin? Devastator? Get ready to find out!

In addition, I have included 11 new weapons, thus completing the entire arsenal and unlockable elements in the game.

I've also made numerous adjustments to the gameplay, including aspects such as damage, mission duration, the number of enemies. These changes may not be evident at first glance, but they are focused on achieving the perfect balance. Also, I have introduced a new design for the logo and several user interface elements.

This journey has been an astonishing experience, full of learning. It hasn't been an easy road, but I always found in you the most solid support to move forward and make this the beginning of my career. There are still many adventures to come!

Thank you so much to all of you. Now, back to work! See you on August 14th!

notes.title: EON Fighter 1.0!
notes.notes:
With great enthusiasm, I am thrilled to announce that the version 1.0 of our game will finally be released on August 15th! I am extremely pleased with the final outcome, including the gameplay, UI changes, and more. I believe that everyone will be able to enjoy a substantial improvement.
New elements like expanding the lore, killstreaks with bonuses, modifications in the gain of experience, new weapons and more. But I don't want to ruin the surprise!

The most important aspect to highlight is the tremendous support I received, the constant feedback, suggestions, and criticisms that helped shape EON Fighter into its final state. Contributions from players like Alex Bourdages, Slieop, Razorlight, BattleFeed, and many others were crucial, and I cannot express enough gratitude towards them.

However, reaching version 1.0 does not mean the development has ended. I will always be able to implement improvements and add more content.
Once again, I sincerely thank each and every one of you, and I genuinely hope you enjoy the version 1.0 of EON Fighter.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 0.14.14
notes.notes:
Update 0.14.14

Hello! I'm Nicolas, the developer of EON Fighter. Before getting into the details of the update, I want to share my experience in developing the game. This is my first complete game and has definitely been a challenge. I have made mistakes and at times made wrong decisions regarding gameplay, but thanks to the enormous support and valuable feedback from many players, I continue to improve and learn. The goal of this update, based on the received feedback, is to make the gaming experience smoother and more balanced, although there is still a long way to go and a lot of content to add. I want to thank everyone for their patience and support in this project and reaffirm my commitment to continue working to improve and find the best ways to make EON Fighter a better game.

Now, let's see the changes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/3f212e6f710d07baed0799c528b4b108c73e8b92.png[/img]

Restructuring of the upgrade system and game progress:

Upgrades are divided into three groups: ship upgrades, primary weapon upgrades, and secondary weapon upgrades. As weapons improve, they will level up, acquiring more projectiles, damage, or range. The most important upgrades, such as damage, health, and shield, are applied with numerical values instead of percentages to have more control and improve the balance between different ships. Mining upgrades have been removed.

All weapon damage variables and enemy health have been modified. The goal is for the player to have the possibility, if they wish, to boost secondary weapons and not rely solely on the primary weapon, increasing the variability of possible combinations.

Obtaining weapons is now independent of scenario progress. They have an indicator represented by a progress bar in the lower left corner. When filled, the player can choose to equip a secondary weapon, switch the primary weapon, or receive general upgrades. The speed of this counter varies depending on the game mode and, in the case of main missions, depends on the level of mining speed upgrades.
The functioning of secondary weapons no longer depends on the proximity of enemies. They now fire automatically whenever there are enemies on the scene, and their firing speed can be reduced through upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/42826dd1308d86d4d00715a1fe746a86fe700dd5.png[/img]

The visible circle around the ship now represents the range of the magnet.

New elements have been added to the UI to show the status of weapons, as well as a pilot avatar that will vary depending on the status of the ship. These elements will be improved in future updates.

The new "Expeditions" mode was introduced. This mode contains several levels, although only the first one is available for now. All levels will present new objectives, mechanics, game modes, enemies, and scenarios, with independent classifications per ship accessible from the menu. The first level is unlocked from the start, and the following ones will be unlocked according to the player's level.

The final list of songs was implemented, with a total of 20 tracks composed by Evgeny Bardyuzh (all incredible!).

Once again, thank you very much to everyone for your support, and I sincerely hope you enjoy this update.

Regards, Nicolas.

notes.title: Update 0.11.12!

Update 0.11.12!

I have received a lot of player feedback regarding weapon overheating, which is why I have implemented a new overheating system:

Previously, if the weapon overheated, it became disabled until it cooled down completely. Now, we have changed that. From now on, if the weapon overheats, it will not be completely disabled, but the firing rate will be significantly reduced. This means that players will not be completely defenseless, but they will have to be more strategic in their use of the weapon and take overheating into account to optimize its effectiveness.

Additionally, we have added a new gameplay mechanism. Just when the weapon overheats, a green marker will appear and an alarm will sound for half a second. If the player releases the fire button and fires again during that time, they will receive a special bonus and the weapon will cool down completely. This will allow players to quickly recover from overheating and get back into action.

notes.title: EON Fighter - State of development
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I'm still moving forward in development and I wanted to show you what the status is.

But first a bit of the history of the Game:

[i]Several centuries into the future, the galaxy is plunged into a great war between different civilizations. Minerals and resources, essential to fuel the war machine, are scarce.
Faced with this challenge, the human race creates the "EON Squad" whose job is to go into extremely dangerous missions, in remote areas of space to collect precious materials.
But are not the only ones. Other factions will be waiting to do battle.
Extraction locations are only accessible by large and powerful cargo ships called EON-25s. The journey is long and dangerous.
Once there, you, as an EON Fighter, must collect the resources and resist the constant enemy attacks, until completing the cargo ship's capacity to 100%, discard your ship and escape in the EON-25.
The task is difficult and essential for the survival of your race, but with each load you deliver you will receive credits with which you can buy upgrades and more powerful ships that improve your chances.
Are you ready for this challenge?[/i]

In terms of gameplay, some aspects of the interface were improved, the cargo ship has a new sprite, and the sizes of explosions and damage were tweaked to clear the screen a bit, especially in situations where there are many enemies and everything becomes chaotic. These changes can now be tested in the demo.

Another element that I wanted to tell you about is the system of permanent improvements and “perks”.
With the money that they collect as they complete levels, you will be able to improve some aspects of the ship. These are permanent and will be added to the base values at the start of the level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/873ffa41a71b433b3345cebece267bd18f5fdc5f.png[/img]

Perks will be unlocked as you complete various tasks, such as killing X number of enemies, X number of bosses, or collecting X number of ores, and others will simply be floating around in space for you to find.
They will have up to three sockets, and for each socket there will be three possibilities of which you can choose only one, although you can change it from level to level. It won't be easy to unlock all the perks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/255307ad1c8fc092f5585e961eca76a5f02133bc.png[/img]

Well, all for now Fighters! Back to work and soon I'll show you the improvements in action!

Greetings to all and thank you very much!
